description: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike (sfiii3n) RAM from MAMEToolkit. Health is a signed 16-bit little-endian value.

P1_HEALTH.note: Player 1 health. Full bar is 160. MAMEToolkit healthP1.

P2_HEALTH.note: Player 2 health. Full bar is 160. MAMEToolkit healthP2.

IN_FIGHT.note: Non-zero while a round is being fought. MAMEToolkit fighting flag.

WINS_P1.note: Rounds won by player 1. MAMEToolkit winsP1.

WINS_P2.note: Rounds won by player 2. MAMEToolkit winsP2.
